resources.string: Owner-controlled backup and verified restore for explicitly selected documents

Swir Backup never reads other apps’ private data or device partitions. Schema-v2 archives record SHA-256 for every selected document and restore only into a folder you explicitly choose. Legacy schema-v1 archives remain inspect-only.
